subject: Cohort Deployment Playground — ops handoff & RSVP
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@cloudscale.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@finedge.co>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick request — group sandbox / deployment playground for evaluation

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. A few of us at CloudScale (Priya and I) would like to run a short "deployment playground" with 3 teams next Tuesday/Wednesday — hands-on, bring your own sample model + inference pipelines. Goal: validate Redwood Dedicated routing and quick quantization workflow end-to-end.

Ideally this is a 60–75 minute session with:
- 10 min intro + objectives
- 40–50 min hands-on breakouts (we'll have devs)
- 10–15 min wrap + next steps / MAP alignment

Do you have availability for any of these slots (PST):
- Tue 12/15 09:00–10:15
- Tue 12/15 13:00–14:15
- Wed 12/16 10:00–11:15

Also: we'd like a short ops handoff doc (who owns the breakout host, walk-through checklist, artifacts). Happy to share our internal checklist if helpful.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Nguyen
CTO, CloudScale AI

Hi Alex — great to hear and totally doable. Thanks for the clear agenda.

We're available for Tue 12/15 13:00–14:15 PST and Wed 12/16 10:00–11:15 PST. The earlier Tue morning slot conflicts with a reserved Dedicated capacity validation run.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Redwood hosts a short platform primer and provides a pre-seeded repo + model artifacts.
- Breakouts split by "inference pattern": low-latency streaming, batching/throughput, embeddings/reranking.
- Hosts: Marissa (breakout 1), Ben (breakout 2), Dylan (breakout 3) — we can swap if you prefer.
- Ops handoff doc attached (redwood-playbook-v1.pdf) and a MAP stub (mutual_action_plan_RWD-2026-2337.xlsx).

Can you confirm which of the two slots you prefer and how many participants per breakout (3–4 devs works best)? Once we lock the slot I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom + ephemeral keys and a Miro board for the breakouts.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Looping Ben in to confirm breakout hosts and to surface a short ops checklist I use for these sessions.

Ben — can you take breakout 2 (batching/throughput)? I’ll run the primer + breakout 1. I suggest we keep breakout rooms flexible (teams choose pattern) and have a floating host for infra issues; Dylan, can you be the floater?

Ops checklist (short):
- Pre-populate ephemeral API keys and ensure per-team KV cache isolation
- Share quantization script and a pre-packed 4-bit wheel (link in playbook)
- Confirm Dedicated pool sizing: reserve 2x small GPUs for Wed run (if Wed chosen)
- Collect one post-session artifact per team (logs + short perf table)

I also added a quick doc to the MAP outlining roles — see attached MAP. If Alex confirms participant counts, I’ll draft calendar invite copy and include the Miro board & Zoom.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
